title: Optimize Algorithm Performance
prompt:
Analyze and optimize the following algorithm:

[PASTE CODE]

## Current Complexity Analysis
- Time complexity: O(?)
- Space complexity: O(?)
- Identify the bottleneck operation
- Profile the hot path (which lines execute most frequently)

## Optimization Strategy
Suggest optimizations in order of impact:
1. Algorithmic improvement (better Big-O)
2. Data structure changes
3. Caching / memoization opportunities
4. Loop optimizations
5. Memory allocation reduction

## Optimized Implementation
Provide the optimized code with:
- Inline comments explaining each optimization
- New time complexity: O(?)
- New space complexity: O(?)
- Trade-offs made (readability, memory, etc.)

## Benchmarking
Provide a benchmark test that compares old vs. new implementation on:
- Small input (n=100)
- Medium input (n=10,000)
- Large input (n=1,000,000)

NOTE: Correctness first. Only optimize after proving the algorithm is correct.
